title: FMS Website
desc: Internal financial management web app built with React.js to improve customer service workflows at KBTG.
fullDesc: The FMS (Financial Management System) Website is an internal tooling application developed at KBTG in 2025 to improve customer service workflows and financial operation management. I contributed to this project using React.js, marking an expansion into modern web development alongside my primary mobile engineering role.
highlights: Built front-end features using React.js for internal customer service workflows
Contributed to UI components that improved operational efficiency for KBTG staff

title: K Plus
desc: Leading mobile banking app in Thailand with millions of users. Contributed to K Plus TH, K Plus Vietnam, and K Plus Biz Vietnam.
fullDesc: K Plus is the flagship mobile banking application of KASIKORN Bank, serving millions of users across Thailand and Vietnam. As a key contributor at K-Soft Co., Ltd. (KBTG), I worked across three variants of the app — K Plus Thailand, K Plus Vietnam, and K Plus Biz Vietnam — while navigating regional challenges in environment, user behavior, and infrastructure.
highlights: Supported Feed, Notification, Tracking Analysis, and Deeplink features for K Plus Thailand
Addressed regional challenges in K Plus Vietnam: environment, user behavior, and infrastructure
Contributed to K Plus Biz Vietnam — mobile banking for SMEs to facilitate seamless transactions

title: K Plus Review Classifier
desc: Multi-label text classification model to analyze and categorize K Plus app store customer feedback — Master's independent study.
fullDesc: This project is a multi-label text classification system developed as a Master's independent study at Chulalongkorn University. The model analyzes and categorizes K Plus app store customer reviews to surface actionable insights for product teams, demonstrating applied machine learning in a real-world banking context.
highlights: Designed and trained a multi-label classification model on K Plus app store reviews
Applied data preparation and feature engineering using Pandas and Scikit-learn
Thesis project for Master of Software Engineering — specialized in data analytics & ML

title: TripPointz
desc: GPS-based iOS app to discover sightseeing spots, restaurants, and shops. Built from scratch with App Store automation via Fastlane.
fullDesc: TripPointz is a location-based iOS application built from the ground up at Samart Digital Media to help users discover sightseeing spots, restaurants, and shops near them. I led the full development cycle from architecture to App Store submission, including implementing an automated deployment pipeline.
highlights: Led development from scratch — architected and built the entire iOS application
Integrated GPS to enable proximity-based discovery of sightseeing, restaurants, and shops
Implemented Fastlane pipeline to automate App Store deployments and streamline releases
